title: Pickaxe world and more
description: now, you can make a lot of pickaxes and more!
body:
I added a lot of pickaxes, if you are intrested, check out in game (:+
The newest things:
Canoon update
I added canoon to minecraft, you can shoot canonballs with it
Muter witch update
I added Muter witch to minecraft, this boss has got very simillar abilities as Mother witch in clash royale
Lucky update
1. Mystery ore-you can get all of the ores from this ore
2. Lucky pickaxe- If you mine stone, you can get all of the ores.
Fixed redstone pickaxe texture
Magnetic pickaxe
I added magnetick pickaxe to minecraft. You can teleport mined blocks to inventory by this tool. Next, i fixed one bug in this mod element. Now, you can try it without any problems! 
Regeneration stick update
Regeneration stick- you can regenerate your health by it
CurseForge - a world of endless gaming possibilities for modders and gamers alike.
